class SpectrumStats(ObservationStats):
    """Spectrum statistics inheriting from ObservationStats."""
    def __init__(self, n_on=None, n_off=None, a_on=None, a_off=None,
                 obs_id=None, livetime=None, alpha=None,
                 gamma_rate=None, bg_rate=None, spectrum_info=None):
        super(SpectrumStats, self).__init__(
            n_on=n_on,
            n_off=n_off,
            a_on=a_on,
            a_off=a_off,
            obs_id=obs_id,
            livetime=livetime,
            alpha=alpha,
            gamma_rate=gamma_rate,
            bg_rate=bg_rate,
        )
        self.spectrum_info = spectrum_info


def total_stats(self):
    """Return `~gammapy.data.ObservationStats"

    ``a_on`` and ``a_off`` are averaged over all energies.
    """
    kwargs = dict(
        n_on=int(self.on_vector.total_counts.value),
        n_off=int(self.off_vector.total_counts.value),
        a_on=np.mean(self.on_vector.backscal),
        a_off=np.mean(self.off_vector.backscal),
        obs_id=self.obs_id,
        livetime=self.livetime,
    )
    return SpectrumStats(**kwargs)
